annotations.title: Check a GitHub repository for security issues

description: Use this when the person wants a public GitHub repository checked for leaked secrets, vulnerable or malicious dependencies and risky code. No code is run. 3 free checks a day per account, then $1 when the check finishes; a failed check costs nothing. Do not use for websites (use scan_url) or private repositories.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string naming this check. Reuse it to collect the result or to retry; the same key is never charged twice.

language.description: The language the person is writing in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "ru".

ref.description: Optional branch name. Default: the repository's default branch.

repo_url.description: A public GitHub repository, for example https://github.com/owner/repo

name: scan_repo
title: Check a GitHub repository for security issues
